name: nano server release (gateway + engine-wasm) with conditional downstream adoption

agent.prompt: In nanobpm/nano-bpm, cut a gateway release following RELEASE.md (the canonical procedure; read it first). Since nano-bpm#1872 @nanobpm/engine-wasm has NO separate version or train: it is stamped from server/Cargo.toml and published from the same `v*` tag, so there is nothing to bump for it. (1) Open ONE version-bump PR titled `chore(release): v<next>`: bump the `version` in server/Cargo.toml and processos/Cargo.toml (the SemVer rules are in RELEASE.md; VERSION FLOOR: npm already holds @nanobpm/engine-wasm 0.1.0-0.11.2 from the retired train, so <next> must be greater than 0.11.2 — the first coupled release is v0.12.0 (from v0.0.28), then normal SemVer from there; check with `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm versions --json` and stop if <next> already exists or is <= the highest published version), refresh console/package-lock.json with `make console-wasm && (cd console && npm install)`, and add nano-bernd only if the FFI ABI changed. Call out every determinism upgrade boundary since the last `v*` tag in the PR body (RELEASE.md section 1a). Converge the PR and merge it (nano-bpm merges via a standalone `@mergifyio queue` comment). (2) From the merge commit on origin/main, run `make release-tags` (dry run), then `make release-tags PUSH=1`; it pushes one tag per push and confirms each release workflow started. Do not hand-push tags. (3) Verify per RELEASE.md section 4: `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm version` equals the new server version, the `v<next>` GitHub release exists, and the gateway's `fix(binary): bundle nanobpmn <version>` PR on jwulf/c8ctl-plugin-nano is open or merged.

wait.target: v=$(gh api repos/nanobpm/nano-bpm/releases/latest --jq .tag_name | sed 's/^v//'); e=$(npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm@$v version 2>/dev/null | tail -1); [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$e" = "$v" ] && echo OK: server v$v and @nanobpm/engine-wasm@$v are live || { echo waiting for @nanobpm/engine-wasm@$v; exit 1; }

emits.name: adopt
emits.description: true when the downstream adoption train must run for this release

agent.prompt: Decide whether the server release that just went live needs the downstream adoption train. Read-only: open no PR, change no files. Let V = `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm version` and P = the previous `v*` tag of nanobpm/nano-bpm. Return adopt=true if ANY of: (a) a consumer's declared @nanobpm/engine-wasm range does not admit V: check `npm view <pkg>@latest dependencies peerDependencies devDependencies` for @nanobpm/engine-testkit, @nanobpm/bojtos-kit, @nanobpm/urban-testkit and @nanobpm/nano-agent-graph-engine, and resolve with `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm@'<range>' version`; (b) the engine-wasm public surface changed between P and v<V>: `git diff P v<V> -- engine-wasm/` touches the exported TypeScript/JS API or DTO types, or the FFI ABI_VERSION changed; (c) the release PR, or any PR merged between P and v<V>, carries the label `adopt-downstream`. Otherwise return adopt=false: consumers on a `^0.<minor>.0` range pick a patch release up without new PRs. Put the rule that fired, with evidence, in your summary.

wait.target: echo downstream adoption not needed for this release

agent.prompt: In nanobpm/nano-bpm clients/engine-testkit: set the @nanobpm/engine-wasm range to the just-published version. engine-wasm shares the nano server version (nano-bpm#1872). The coupled scheme starts at 0.12.0: the server jumped from v0.0.28 to v0.12.0 so engine-wasm versions stay above the retired engine-wasm train's 0.11.2 (0.1.0-0.11.2 already exist on npm, so the server must never publish 0.0.x or any version <= 0.11.2). Declare a caret range on the just-published minor, `^<version>` (on 0.x that is >=<version> <0.<minor+1>.0, the same as tilde), so later server patches flow through without another adopt PR. Read the version with `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm version`; replace any ^0.11.x or older range. Build and test, then cut @nanobpm/engine-testkit (release-engine-testkit-npm.yml, OIDC) per RELEASE.md, and confirm the new version is on npm.

In nanobpm/bojtos (one repo, semantic-release from .releaserc.json; bojtos-kit and bojtos-react are published together under one vX.Y.Z tag by scripts/release.mjs): set the @nanobpm/engine-wasm range in bojtos-kit/package.json (and anywhere else it is declared) to the just-published version. engine-wasm shares the nano server version (nano-bpm#1872). The coupled scheme starts at 0.12.0: the server jumped from v0.0.28 to v0.12.0 so engine-wasm versions stay above the retired engine-wasm train's 0.11.2 (0.1.0-0.11.2 already exist on npm, so the server must never publish 0.0.x or any version <= 0.11.2). Declare a caret range on the just-published minor, `^<version>` (on 0.x that is >=<version> <0.<minor+1>.0, the same as tilde), so later server patches flow through without another adopt PR. Read the version with `npm view @nanobpm/engine-wasm version`; replace any ^0.11.x or older range. Update lockfiles, build and test both packages, and land it with a conventional `feat:`/`fix:` PR title so semantic-release cuts a release on merge. Do not bump versions by hand. Wait for the release workflow to finish and confirm both @nanobpm/bojtos-kit and @nanobpm/bojtos-react were published at the new version.

wait.target: for u in @nanobpm/engine-wasm; do r=; for s in dependencies devDependencies peerDependencies; do r=$(npm view @nanobpm/bojtos-kit@latest $s.$u 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && break; done; [ -z "$r" ] && { echo no declared range for $u in @nanobpm/bojtos-kit; exit 1; }; m=$(npm view "$u@$r" version 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d "'" | awk '{print $NF}'); l=$(npm view $u version 2>/dev/null); [ "$m" = "$l" ] || { echo $u: range $r resolves $m not latest $l; exit 1; }; done; echo OK: @nanobpm/bojtos-kit resolves forward

for u in @nanobpm/bojtos-kit; do r=; for s in dependencies devDependencies peerDependencies; do r=$(npm view @nanobpm/bojtos-react@latest $s.$u 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && break; done; [ -z "$r" ] && { echo no declared range for $u in @nanobpm/bojtos-react; exit 1; }; m=$(npm view "$u@$r" version 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d "'" | awk '{print $NF}'); l=$(npm view $u version 2>/dev/null); [ "$m" = "$l" ] || { echo $u: range $r resolves $m not latest $l; exit 1; }; done; echo OK: @nanobpm/bojtos-react resolves forward

agent.prompt: Sink: in nanobpm/nano-bpm (console/ subdir) bump the @nanobpm/bojtos-kit and @nanobpm/bojtos-react ranges to the just-published versions, build and test, and open the adopt PR. Do NOT touch engine-wasm: since nano-bpm#1872 the console embeds the same-commit engine-wasm, not a published range. Mode D: complete the job returning surface="missing" if the console needs an API the just-published upstream does NOT yet expose (a surface extension you must NOT force locally); else surface="ok".

Sink: in nano-workforce bump @nanobpm/urban + urban-testkit + workflow ranges, build+test, release @nanobpm/nano-workforce (semantic-release, CI-token). Mode A: complete the job returning result="breaking" if adopting required a non-mechanical code migration (ADR-0065-shaped, not just a range bump); else result="green".

Mode-A migration (breaking upstream): in nano-workforce perform the ADR-0065-shaped code migration for the new @nanobpm/urban major surface (mirror nano-workforce#489 — read the migration notes, adapt call sites, don't just bump the range), build+test, then release @nanobpm/nano-workforce (semantic-release, CI-token).
